newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HSI Services to launch China play index on June 16.
newsitem.headline: HSI Services to launch China play index on June 16.

text.p: HSI Services Ltd, the keeper of Hong Kong's blue-chip Hang Seng Index, said on Thursday it would launch a new index on June 16 to track the performance of China-affiliated companies.
A spokeswoman said details would be announced at a news conference at 4 p.m. (0800 GMT) on Friday.
She declined to give further details.
HSI Services said last month it would choose the stocks for the new index based on the level of China control.
There is already an H-share index of China-incorporated companies listed in Hong Kong.
